description: This PHP class defines the EmployeeSkill filter field used in the reporting system of OrangeHRM. It provides methods to add query conditions based on the skill of an employee, retrieve entity aliases, and convert the filter value to an array representation, integrating with the SkillService to fetch skill details.

classes.name: EmployeeSkill
classes.description: Represents a filter field for employee skills in report generation, enabling filtering by specific skill and converting filter values to an array with skill details.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a filtering condition to the query if the operator is EQUAL and the filter value is set, filtering by employee skill.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the database entity alias used in query building, in this case 'skill'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the filter's value to an array containing the skill's id and label if the skill exists.
